title: State-City Code master (MCX)
purpose: MCX's list of State-City codes for fields 15 and 22 of the UCC file (published separately and revised by circular, e.g. MCX/S&I/507/2024). Save it as CSV with a header row: Ledgerline finds the state, city and code columns by their header names, as MCX's layout is not published with the UCC file formats.
linked: Loaded as MCX's State-City codes for the MCX UCC file; columns are found by their header names (state, city, code), in any order, with other columns ignored
source: Column names assumed: MCX publishes the State-City Code master separately from MCX/TECH/023/2022 (MCX UCC File Formats v1.0) and its layout was not available
